label: D1 after an unrewarded trial, early in the episode (trials 1-17)
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 0 (previous trial unrewarded); never at GO or D2, never after a rewarded trial. Strongly restricted to early episode: rate ~16% at ep_trial 1-2, ~9% at 3-9, ~1% at 10-49, zero after trial ~30 and at trial 0. Within early-episode unrewarded D1s it fires about half the time; somewhat more after a2 choices, after switches, and in the few trials after a reversal, but adding prev_action did not help much. Activation is in a narrow value-head range (7.1-7.7). Magnitudes are tiny and roughly uniform; did not find a magnitude modulator. Likely a no-reward detector whose candidate drive is offset by a slow episode-time / hidden-state drift, so the episode-time cutoff is a proxy. Only observed variables used.
